arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# High-grade corporate bond yields
feb_1943 = 2.68
feb_1944 = 2.65
jan_1945 = 2.58

# Benchmark yield
benchmark = 2.60

# Calculate absolute differences
diff_1943 = abs(feb_1943 - benchmark)
diff_1944 = abs(feb_1944 - benchmark)
diff_1945 = abs(jan_1945 - benchmark)

print(f'February 1943: {feb_1943}, diff: {diff_1943}')
print(f'February 1944: {feb_1944}, diff: {diff_1944}')
print(f'January 1945: {jan_1945}, diff: {diff_1945}')

# Calculate mean of absolute differences
avg_deviation = (diff_1943 + diff_1944 + diff_1945) / 3

print(f'\nAverage deviation: {avg_deviation}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(avg_deviation, 2)}')
"
